::: {.minipage data-latex="{\textwidth}"}
### `GetMinimumDownloadFileSizeInKilobytes`

Returns the minimum file size (in kilobytes)\index{web harvester!settings} that a file must be to be downloaded.

#### Syntax {-}

``` {.lua}
number GetMinimumDownloadFileSizeInKilobytes()
```


#### Return value {-}

Type: `number`


:::
